title: WHO Global Health Observatory — Western Pacific Island Country Indicators
description: WHO GHO OData indicator WHOSIS_000002 (healthy life expectancy (HALE) at birth) for Pacific Island member states of the WHO Western Pacific Region.
notes: WHO data is generally CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO — non-commercial, which conflicts with x402 resale. RESTRICTED so a human decides whether a free/research-tier endpoint is allowed. GHO OData API; the fetcher appends $format=json&$top=1000. The response covers all WHO member states, not only Pacific ones. Stage 02b: direct data-file URL, not live-verified (build sandbox has no outbound network to this host) — confirm with a live fetch before relying on it.

title: Pacific Monitoring Alliance for NCD Action (MANA) Dashboard
description: SPC-coordinated dashboard tracking Pacific countries' progress on NCD policy and legislation.
notes: Pacific NCD policy-status data (the NCD crisis is the region's leading health burden). Exact dashboard URL and licence to confirm. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) — Pacific
description: Annual national immunisation coverage estimates (DTP3, MCV1/2, etc.) for Pacific Island countries.
notes: UNICEF data published under CC BY 3.0 IGO. Confirmed open licence. Reuse permitted with attribution. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: Pacific Data Hub — Health Indicators
description: SPC PDH.stat WHO/UNICEF immunisation coverage dataflow (DF_WHO_UNICEF_IMMUNISATION), annual series, served as SDMX-CSV.
notes: Regional health indicator catalogue. Licence varies per dataset; not confirmed. Stage 02b: direct data-file URL, not live-verified (build sandbox has no outbound network to this host) — confirm with a live fetch before relying on it.

title: Samoa Ministry of Health Annual Health Statistics
description: Samoa Ministry of Health annual reports and health statistics bulletins.
notes: National-level source for Samoa health data (OGIP-adjacent ministry). PDF reports — exercises document extraction. Licence not stated. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.
